What is an online invitation maker?

An online invitation maker is a web tool for designing invitations without design software. You choose a template, change the text, colors and photos, and export or share the finished invitation.

MyInviteQR goes further than a static image: your invitation is a live web page with an RSVP button, a QR code and guest tracking, so it works as your whole invitation and guest-list tool.

Free to design and preview. Pay once only when you publish.

Tips for designing a great invitation

  • Keep the most important details, date and place, large and near the top.
  • Limit yourself to two or three fonts.
  • Use high-resolution photos.
  • Make sure text has strong contrast with the background.
  • Preview on a phone before you publish.

What to include on your invitation

A checklist so nothing is missing.

Who: the host and the guest of honor.
What: the type of event and any theme or dress code.
When and where: the date, start time, address and parking.
How to reply: the RSVP button and a reply-by date.

Invitation maker invitation questions

Is the invitation maker really free?

Yes. Designing, previewing and saving drafts are free. You pay once only when you publish the invitation to share it with guests.

Do I need design skills?

No. Start from a template and change the details. The editor is drag and drop.

Can I upload my own photos?

Yes. Upload JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF files up to 5 MB each.

Can I use it on my phone?

Guests can view invitations on any phone. Designing works best on a computer or tablet.
